notes.en: Static guide review draft: pinned source, exact license bytes, method adaptation, synthetic examples and the evidence/authority boundary were checked. The draft response attributes reported timing and scope, recommends linking without claiming a merge, and never claims ticket creation, routing, assignment, escalation, closure or a sent reply. No script, dependency, connector or execution is present. This unsigned draft is not a production review approval and makes no model-run, guest-execution, installation or App acceptance claim.
notes.zh-Hans: 静态指南审核草稿：已检查固定来源、完整许可字节、方法适配、合成示例及证据/权限边界。起草回复将客户报告的时间与范围归因于报告，建议关联但不声称已合并，也不声称创建、路由、指派、升级、关闭工单或已发送回复。不附带脚本、依赖、外部连接或执行。此未签名草稿不是生产审核批准，也不声明模型运行、来宾执行、安装或 App 验收。
